blocks.text: Sulfuric acid banane ke liye sulfur trioxide SO2 aur O2 se reversible amal mein banti hai, 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g), delta H = -97.9 kJ fi mol. Le Chatelier ke usool se zyada dabao aur kam darja hararat SO3 ki behtar yield ke halaat hain. Kam darja hararat par SO3 banne ka equilibrium constant bara hai magar equilibrium bohat aahista pohnchta hai; darja hararat barhne par rate barhti hai magar SO3 ki yield girti hai. Table 8.2 1 atmosphere par position dikhati hai.

blocks.caption: 1 atm par SO3 equilibrium par darja hararat ka asar (Table 8.2)

blocks.text: Munasib waqt mein SO3 ki behtareen yield ke liye SO2(g) aur O2(g) (hawa ke taur par) ka mixture ek atmosphere par V2O5 jaise solid catalyst par guzara jata hai. Kyunke reaction exothermic hai gas ka darja hararat 600 degrees C tak barhta hai, to SO3(g) ki yield barhane ke liye equilibrium mixture 400 se 500 degrees C ke kam darja hararat par recycle kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Table 8.2 se wazahat karein ke contact process sirf 200 degrees C par kyun nahi chalta, jahan 98 feesad sulfur dioxide badal jati hai.
blocks.explanation: 200 degrees C par Kc 5500 aur equilibrium yield 98 feesad hai, magar reaction mufeed waqt mein us equilibrium tak pohnchne ke liye bohat sust hai. 400 se 500 degrees C par, vanadium pentoxide catalyst ke saath, rate zyada hai aur yield (equilibrium par 75 se 61 feesad) ab bhi achhi hai; exothermic garmi ke baad is kam darja hararat par gases recycle karna baqi SO2 ka zyada hissa badalta hai.

items: 2SO2 + O2 se 2SO3, exothermic (-97.9 kJ fi mol): kam darja hararat bara Kc aur zyada yield deta hai (200 degrees C par 98 feesad) magar aahista; zyada darja hararat tez hai magar yield girti hai (700 degrees C par 31 feesad).
Behtareen: SO2 aur hawa 1 atm par V2O5 par; gas 600 degrees C tak garam hoti hai, to mixture 400 se 500 degrees C par recycle hota hai.
